theses.question: Was the deportation of 1915 a wartime relocation or the destruction of a people, and what does the free record hold about who decided it and how many died?
How many died under Democratic Kampuchea, who counts as a victim of the genocide, and what does the free record settle about the prison whose registers the court read?

Who freed the enslaved of Saint-Domingue, what did the French state say it was sending an army to do, and what did the free record settle about the declaration of 1804 and the price France set on it in 1825?
What did the boundary commissions work from, why did Gurdaspur go to India, and what does the free record settle about the force, the dead and the displaced?
What did the General Act of Berlin actually allocate, what did the rules it laid down cost the people on the coasts and in the Congo basin, and what does the free record settle about the counts?
How many people the pandemic of 1918 killed, why every count of them is an estimate, and what the free record settles about the name, the waves and the unequal dying.
Was the safe area lost on 11 July 1995, or was it never held, and what does the free record settle about the men taken from it?
